definitions: Ectopic lymphoid aggregates that form in non-lymphoid tissues at sites of chronic inflammation, infection, or cancer.
Organized collections of immune cells that resemble secondary lymphoid organs but develop outside of typical lymphatic locations.
examples: The presence of tertiary lymphoid structures often correlates with disease progression.
Researchers are studying the role of tertiary lymphoid structures in autoimmune diseases.
Targeting tertiary lymphoid structures could be a therapeutic strategy.
